sections.name: top_bar
sections.description: Single orange bar: Y logo, 'Hacker News' bold link, then nav links separated by '|', with 'login' right-aligned.

sections.name: story_list
sections.description: 30 numbered story rows, each a single line: rank, upvote triangle, title link with (domain) in parens, then a subline with points, author 'by' link, time ago, hide, and discuss/comments count — e.g. '1. Show HN: I built a local-first Postgres GUI in Rust (github.com/pgwave)', '2. Llama 3.1 405B weights released (ai.meta.com)', '3. Why CRDTs are harder than they look (jakelazaroff.com)'.

sections.name: pagination
sections.description: Indented 'More' link at the bottom leading to page 2.

sections.name: footer
sections.description: Thin orange divider followed by links: Guidelines, FAQ, Lists, API, Security, Legal, Apply to YC, Contact, and a search box.

sections.name: top_bar
sections.description: Same orange nav bar with 'new' emphasized.

sections.name: newest_list
sections.description: 30 freshly submitted, mostly low-point stories with 'flag' link visible — e.g. 'Our Series A pitch deck template (notion.so)', 'Ask HN: Anyone else seeing GPT-4o latency spikes today?', '[dead] Buy cheap followers 2023 (spamdomain.ru)'.

sections.name: ask_list
sections.description: 30 'Ask HN:' posts with higher comment counts than points — e.g. 'Ask HN: What are you working on in October 2023?', 'Ask HN: Best resources to learn CUDA in 2023?', 'Ask HN: I'm 42 and burned out — what next?'.

sections.name: pagination
sections.description: 'More' link to older Ask HN posts.

sections.name: top_bar
sections.description: Orange nav bar with 'show' emphasized; small intro line linking to showhn guidelines.

sections.name: show_list
sections.description: 30 'Show HN:' launches with domains — e.g. 'Show HN: Tldraw – an infinite canvas SDK (tldraw.com)', 'Show HN: I replaced Zapier with 200 lines of Deno (github.com/marko)', 'Show HN: Offline-first Markdown editor for iPad (ergojot.app)'.

sections.name: pagination
sections.description: 'More' link to older Show HN entries.

sections.name: jobs_list
sections.description: 30 numbered YC company job postings, no upvote arrow, format 'Company (YC Wxx) Is Hiring a Role — Location (remote ok)' — e.g. 'Retool (YC W17) Is Hiring a Senior Backend Engineer — San Francisco', 'Pave (YC S19) Is Hiring a Founding Designer — Remote (US)', 'Speak (YC W17) Is Hiring iOS Engineers — Seoul / SF'.
